e: Earth ka mantle mostly ultra-dense crystalline solid rock (peridotite) hai, jisme sirf Asthenosphere ka chhota upper part (~1-2%) partially molten plastic behave karta hai.

qe: What happens to the density of the atmosphere with 'Increasing Altitude'?
qh: 'बढ़ती ऊँचाई' के साथ वायुमंडल के घनत्व का क्या होता है?
e: Altitude badhne par gravitational pull kam hota hai aur upar ki air ka compressive weight decrease hota hai, isliye atmospheric density rapidly decrease hoti hai.

qe: Which gas is a byproduct of 'Radioactive decay' of Potassium-40?
qh: पोटेशियम-40 के 'रेडियोधर्मी क्षय' का उपोत्पाद (byproduct) कौन सी गैस है?
e: Crustal rocks me naturally occurring radioactive Potassium-40 isotope decay hokar radiogenic inert noble gas Argon-40 banata hai.

qe: The 'Troposphere' contains approximately what percentage of the total atmospheric mass?
qh: क्षोभमंडल में कुल वायुमंडलीय द्रव्यमान का लगभग कितना प्रतिशत होता है?
e: Gravity ke chalte air molecules surface par compress rehte hain, isliye pure atmospheric mass ka lagbhag 75% se 80% hissa akele Troposphere me pack hota hai.

qe: Which layer of the atmosphere is closest to the Earth's surface?
qh: वायुमंडल की कौन सी परत पृथ्वी की सतह के सबसे करीब है?
e: Troposphere Earth's surface se directly contact me rehne wali sabse lowest aur fundamental layer hai jahan saari life aur weather activities exist karti hain.

qe: The boundary separating the Troposphere from the Stratosphere is called:
qh: क्षोभमंडल को समताप मंडल से अलग करने वाली सीमा कहलाती है:
e: Tropopause wo thermal inversion boundary hai jahan normal lapse rate stop ho jata hai aur troposphere khatam hokar stratosphere shuru hota hai.

qe: In which layer of the atmosphere do most commercial 'Airplanes' prefer to fly for a smooth ride?
qh: सुचारू उड़ान के लिए अधिकांश वाणिज्यिक 'हवाई जहाज' वायुमंडल की किस परत में उड़ना पसंद करते हैं?
e: Commercial jet airliners lower Stratosphere (~10-12 km) me cruise karte hain kyunki ye zone badlo, convective storms aur convective weather turbulence se bilkul free hota hai.

qe: What happens to the 'Temperature' in the Stratosphere as altitude increases?
qh: ऊँचाई बढ़ने के साथ समताप मंडल (Stratosphere) में 'तापमान' का क्या होता है?
o: It increases due to the presence of Ozone
e: Stratosphere me present ozone molecules solar UV rays ko directly absorb karti hain, jisse layer me unchayi badhne par temperature -56°C se badhkar ~0°C tak chala jata hai.

qe: Which is the 'Coldest' layer of the atmosphere where temperature drops to minus 100°C?
qh: वायुमंडल की सबसे 'ठंडी' परत कौन सी है जहाँ तापमान माइनस 100 डिग्री सेल्सियस तक गिर जाता है?
e: Mesosphere atmospheric envelope ki coldest thermal layer hai jiska top boundary (mesopause at ~85 km) record -100°C (-148°F) tak freeze rehta hai.

qe: The 'Ionosphere' is important for which modern technology?
qh: 'आयनमंडल' किस आधुनिक तकनीक के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है?
o: Radio communication (reflecting radio waves back to Earth)
e: Ionosphere me free electrons aur ions solar radiation se charged rehte hain jo high-frequency radio waves ko reflect karke over-the-horizon wireless communication allow karte hain.

qe: Which layer is the 'Outermost' part of the atmosphere that eventually merges with outer space?
qh: वायुमंडल का 'सबसे बाहरी' भाग कौन सा है जो अंततः अंतरिक्ष के साथ मिल जाता है?
e: Exosphere Earth's atmosphere ki extreme outermost frontier hai jahan light gases (hydrogen, helium) ke atoms rare hote hain aur space ke vacuum ke sath merge ho jaate hain.

qe: The 'Greenhouse Effect' is primarily caused by which type of solar radiation being trapped?
qh: 'ग्रीनहाउस प्रभाव' मुख्य रूप से किस प्रकार के सौर विकिरण के फंसने (trap) के कारण होता है?
e: Earth ki surface se space ki taraf nikalne wali Outgoing Longwave Terrestrial Infrared radiation ko greenhouse gases absorb karke trap karti hain.

qe: The term 'Latent Heat' is associated with:
qh: 'गुप्त ऊष्मा' (Latent Heat) का संबंध किससे है:
o: Change of state of matter (e.g., vapor to liquid) without changing temperature
e: Latent heat wo hidden thermodynamic energy hai jo temperature me koi change kiye bina substance ke physical phase change (jaise liquid se vapor ya vapor se liquid) ke dauraan transfer hoti hai.

qe: The process of 'Hydration' in rocks leads to:
qh: शैलों में 'जलयोजन' (Hydration) की प्रक्रिया क्या करती है?
o: Expansion and swelling of minerals after absorbing water
e: Chemical weathering me jab minerals water molecules ko apne crystal lattice me integrate karte hain, toh wo swell aur expand hokar rock ko mechanically weak kar dete hain.

qe: What is the primary difference between 'Weathering' and 'Erosion'?
qh: 'अपक्षय' (Weathering) और 'अपरदन' (Erosion) के बीच प्राथमिक अंतर क्या है?
o: Weathering involves movement; Erosion is static
Weathering is static (on-site); Erosion involves transportation of material
e: Weathering ek in-situ (static) breakdown process hai jisme chattan apni jagah toot-ti hai; Erosion me kinetic agents (wind, water) toote hue material ko actively transport karte hain.

qe: In the context of 'Plate Tectonics', which plate is a 'Major Plate'?
qh: 'प्लेट विवर्तनिकी' के संदर्भ में, कौन सी प्लेट एक 'मुख्य प्लेट' है?
e: Antarctica and surrounding oceanic lithosphere Earth ki 7 primary major tectonic plates me aati hai, jabki Nazca, Cocos aur Arabian minor plates hain.

qe: Which seismic wave moves like a 'Slinky' or sound wave (Push-Pull)?
qh: कौन सी भूकंपीय तरंग 'स्लिंकी' या ध्वनि तरंग (पुश-पुल) की तरह चलती है?
e: P-waves (Primary waves) longitudinal compression-rarefaction waves hoti hain jo particles ko propagation direction me aage-peeche (push-pull) move karwati hain, slinky spring ki tarah.

qe: Which mineral is Assigned Hardness 10 on the Mohs Scale?
qh: मोह स्केल पर किस खनिज को कठोरता 10 दी गई है?
e: Diamond crystal structure carbon atoms ke dense covalent framework se banta hai aur ye Mohs scale par level 10 ka benchmark mineral hai.

qe: The 'Geoid' shape of the Earth results in higher gravity at the ______.
qh: पृथ्वी के 'जॉइड' आकार के कारण गुरुत्वाकर्षण कहाँ अधिक होता है?
e: Polar flattening ke chalte poles Earth ke center of mass se kareeb hote hain; distance kam hone se gravitational acceleration (g) poles par maximum hota hai.

qe: Which element is the second most abundant in the Earth's crust?
qh: पृथ्वी की क्रस्ट में दूसरा सबसे प्रचुर मात्रा में पाया जाने वाला तत्व कौन सा है?
e: Earth ki crust me mass ke according 1st element Oxygen (~46.6%) hai aur 2nd most abundant element Silicon (~27.7%) hai.

qe: The term 'Mafic' rocks implies they are rich in:
qh: 'मैफ़िक' चट्टानों का तात्पर्य है कि वे भरपूर हैं:
e: Mafic silicate rocks me 'Ma' stands for Magnesium aur 'Fic' stands for Ferric/Iron minerals; ye rocks heavy aur dark-colored hoti hain.

qe: What is 'Regolith' in the context of soil layers?
qh: मिट्टी की परतों के संदर्भ में 'रेगोलिथ' क्या है?
e: Solid bedrock ke upar jami hui loose weathered rock fragments, gravel aur decomposed mitti ki layer ko Regolith bolte hain.

qe: A 'Batholith' is specifically which type of igneous feature?
qh: 'बैथोलिथ' विशेष रूप से किस प्रकार की आग्नेय विशेषता है?
e: Batholith crust ke gehre interior me slow cooling se crystalized hone wala gigantic granitic plutonic body hota hai jo mountain chains ka base banata hai.

qe: In the process of 'Subduction', which plate goes under?
qh: 'प्रविष्ठन' (Subduction) की प्रक्रिया में कौन सी प्लेट नीचे जाती है?
e: Tectonic collision ke time negative buoyancy ke chalte hamesha Denser (bhaari) plate lighter overriding plate ke niche mantle me sink hoti hai.

qe: Which property of minerals refers to the 'Color of Powder'?
qh: खनिजों का कौन सा गुण 'चूर्ण के रंग' को संदर्भित करता है?
e: Unglazed streak plate par mineral ko ghisne se nikalne wala true powder color Streak kehlata hai jo visual impurity color se zyada reliable hota hai.

qe: The 'Normal Lapse Rate' is valid for which layer?
qh: 'सामान्य ह्रास दर' किस परत के लिए मान्य है?
e: Normal Lapse Rate (~6.5°C per km decline) standard theoretical vertical cooling profile hai jo exclusively Troposphere layer par apply hota hai.

qe: What creates the 'Magnetic Field' of the Earth as discussed in the core sections?
qh: कोर अनुभागों में चर्चा के अनुसार पृथ्वी का 'चुंबकीय क्षेत्र' क्या बनाता है?
o: Convection in the liquid outer core
e: Earth ke liquid outer core me conductive molten iron-nickel ke thermal convection aur rotational Coriolis twisting se geodynamo effect chalta hai jo magnetic field banata hai.

qe: Which layer of the atmosphere is 'Coldest'?
qh: वायुमंडल की कौन सी परत 'सर्वाधिक ठंडी' है?
e: Mesosphere Earth atmosphere ki sabse coldest thermal zone hai jiska upper boundary mesopause record -100°C temperature touch karta hai.

qe: The term 'Sial' is associated with which elements?
qh: 'सियाल' शब्द किन तत्वों से जुड़ा है?
e: Sial continental crust ki composition ko describe karta hai jisme primary elements Silicon (Si) aur Aluminum (Al) rich hote hain.

qe: Which seismic wave travels fastest through 'Solids, Liquids, and Gases'?
qh: कौन सी भूकंपीय तरंग 'ठोस, तरल और गैस' तीनों में सबसे तेज चलती है?
e: P-waves (Primary waves) compressional longitudinal nature ki hoti hain aur inka velocity modulus solids, liquids aur gases teeno state me sabse high hota hai.

qe: The 'Asthenosphere' is primarily made of which rock type?
qh: एस्थेनोस्फीयर मुख्य रूप से किस शैल प्रकार से बनी है?
e: Upper mantle ki ductile Asthenosphere dense ultramafic peridotite rock (olivine + pyroxene rich) se compose hoti hai.

qe: What defines the 'Texture' of a soil?
qh: मिट्टी के 'टेक्सचर' (Texture) को क्या परिभाषित करता है?
o: Relative proportions of sand, silt, and clay
e: Soil me present individual grain size distribution (sand, silt aur clay ka proportional ratio) hi soil texture define karta hai.

qe: Which type of 'Process' is 'Volcanism'?
qh: 'ज्वालामुखीयता' (Volcanism) किस प्रकार की प्रक्रिया है?
e: Volcanism Earth's interior geothermal heat aur magma circulation se drive hota hai, isliye ye ek Endogenic (internal) geological process hai.

qe: The term 'Nife' refers to Earth's core because of:
qh: 'निफे' शब्द पृथ्वी के कोर को संदर्भित करता है क्योंकि:
e: Nife acronym core ke primary metallic constituents Nickel (Ni) aur Ferrous yaani Iron (Fe) ke chemical symbols ko denote karta hai.

qe: What creates 'Domes' on the crust according to endogenic theory?
qh: एंडोजेनिक सिद्धांत के अनुसार क्रस्ट पर 'गुंबद' कौन बनाता है?
o: Domal uplift and pressure from rising convection currents
e: Mantle se rising convection plumes aur localized magma intrusions crustal strata ko upar ki taraf arch karke structural domes banate hain.

qe: Which seismic wave is the most 'Destructive'?
qh: कौन सी भूकंपीय तरंग सर्वाधिक 'विनाशकारी' है?
e: Surface waves (Love aur Rayleigh) crustal surface par propagate karti hain aur inka amplitude bohot bada hota hai, jisse structures collapse ho jaate hain.

qe: The 'Geoid' shape implies Earth is flattened at the:
qh: 'जॉइड' आकार का तात्पर्य है कि पृथ्वी कहाँ चपटी है?
e: Earth ke rotation ke centrifugal effect ke chalte mass equator par bulged rehta hai aur dono polar axes par zameen slightly flattened (chapti) hoti hai.

qe: Which mineral has a hardness level of 1?
qh: किस खनिज का कठोरता स्तर 1 है?
e: Mohs hardness scale par level 1 ka baseline softest mineral Talc hai jisko naakhun se bhi scratch kiya ja sakta hai.

qe: Which 'Exogenic' process levels out the heights created by 'Endogenic' forces?
qh: कौन सी 'बाह्य' प्रक्रिया 'आंतरिक' बलों द्वारा बनाई गई ऊँचाइयों को समतल करती है?
e: Endogenic forces pahad banati hain, jabki exogenic processes (weathering aur erosion) unhe kaat kar aur sediments ko basins me fill karke landscape ko level karti hain.

qe: The term 'Bravais Lattice' relates to which geological material?
qh: 'ब्रेवाइस लैटिस' शब्द किस भूवैज्ञानिक पदार्थ से संबंधित है?
e: Crystallography me 14 unique mathematical 3D spatial arrangements hote hain jinme mineral crystals ke internal atoms pack hote hain, unhe Bravais Lattices bolte hain.

qe: The 'Grand Canyon' is a larger version of a ______.
qh: 'ग्रैंड कैनियन' किसका एक बड़ा संस्करण है?
e: Canyons gorges ka hi wider step-like variant hote hain; Grand Canyon Colorado river ke deep vertical downcutting se bani massive Gorge formation hai.

qe: Which type of 'Moraine' is found in the middle of a combined glacier?
qh: एक संयुक्त हिमनद के बीच में कौन सा 'हिमोढ़' (Moraine) पाया जाता है?
e: Jab do tributary glaciers aapas me merge hote hain, toh unke inner lateral moraines jud kar central glacier ke beech me Medial Moraine banate hain.

qe: What defines the 'Texture' of soil?
qh: मिट्टी के 'टेक्सचर' (Texture) को क्या परिभाषित करता है?
o: The size and proportions of sand, silt, and clay particles
e: Soil texture mitti me present individual mineral grain sizes (sand, silt, clay) ke relative percentage ratio ko designate karta hai.

qe: A 'Hanging valley' is formed when:
qh: एक 'लटकती घाटी' (Hanging valley) तब बनती है जब:
o: A river flows over a mountain
A small tributary glacier joins a large main glacier valley
e: Main valley glacier ka ice volume zyada hone se wo valley floor ko deeply erode kar deta hai, jisse chhota tributary glacier pighalne par uski valley upar hanging dikhti hai.

qe: The 'Geoid' shape implies Earth is bulged at the:
qh: 'जॉइड' (Geoid) आकार का तात्पर्य है कि पृथ्वी कहाँ उभरी हुई है?
e: Planetary rotation ke outward centrifugal inertia ke chalte Earth ka diameter poles ke comparison me Equator par bulged (ubhra hua) hota hai.

qe: What is 'Erosion' as defined by kinetic energy?
qh: गतिज ऊर्जा द्वारा परिभाषित 'अपरदन' क्या है?
o: Breaking and moving materials through geomorphic agents
e: Erosion active dynamic geomorphic process hai jisme mobile agents (behta paani, hawa, glacier) apni kinetic energy use karke weathered rock debris ko transport karte hain.

qe: Which layer is the main source of magma for volcanoes?
qh: ज्वालामुखियों के लिए मैग्मा का मुख्य स्रोत कौन सी परत है?
e: Upper mantle me located semi-molten ductile Asthenosphere hi volcanic eruptions me bahar aane wale magma chambers ka primary source hoti hai.
